k1-zero-row-e.what: output row of `e` (weights and bias) set to 0

k2-negate-row-n.what: output row of `n` (weights and bias) negated

k3-swap-rows-e-n.what: output rows of `e` and `n` swapped (weights and bias)

k5-output-weight-x2.what: output layer weight matrix x2 (bias unchanged)

k6-lstm16-x0.5.what: last BiLSTM block (L_16, all weights and biases) x0.5

k7-noise-lstm14.what: Gaussian noise on the weights of BiLSTM L_14, norm 25 % of the block's

k9-noise-all-10pct.what: diffuse: Gaussian noise on every weight tensor, 10 % of each tensor's norm

k10-noise-lstm14-60pct.what: Gaussian noise on the weights of BiLSTM L_14, norm 60 % of the block's

k11-lstm-all-x0.9.what: diffuse: all three BiLSTM blocks (weights and biases) x0.9

k8-zero-conv-c3.what: conv block C_3 (weights and bias) set to 0

k1-zero-row-e-u.what: output row of `e` (weights and bias) set to 0 [unrelated donor]

k6-lstm16-x0.5-u.what: last BiLSTM block (L_16, all weights and biases) x0.5 [unrelated donor]

k8-zero-conv-c3-u.what: conv block C_3 (weights and bias) set to 0 [unrelated donor]
